installationProposal.observationScope: One context at capture time; no global or historical absence claim.
installationProposal.branchRule: Confirm target and retained data before staging. A discovered installation returns to the original migration branch; never infer a prior deployment from package releases.

acceptedEnvelope.rtoScope: Outages beginning within declared response coverage; prepared-capacity restore, no HA or standby.

dirtyInputs: Pre-existing working-tree edits preserved; this packet is also uncommitted.

releaseIdentity.owner: Platform publication owner with Builds and module owners
releaseIdentity.boundary: Local source fingerprints and catalog version inputs are not clean build, attestation, publication, deployed artifact or current remote Platform evidence.

folders-server.boundary: Folders OIDC options configure public bearer validation. Workload assertions use the shared EventStore JWT contract; a human receipt separately authorizes /process. Secret material stays external.

folders-workers.owner: Folders; Platform binds the isolated inbound broker component
folders-workers.boundary: Existing isolated inbound component name is a conformance input; Platform must qualify broker, declarative subscriptions, concurrency, retries and dead letters. Shared pubsub remains outbound.

folders-ui.owner: Folders and FrontComposer; Platform owns confidential UI identity integration
folders-ui.boundary: Current options expose no ClientSecret key. The current bearer forwarding handler is source input; qualified confidential UI credentials and downstream delegation remain unresolved. Never use hermetic-test auth for staging qualification.

folders-sdk.owner: Folders SDK; consuming host owns transport and authentication
folders-sdk.boundary: This key belongs to the SDK parameterless configuration overload. Projects uses explicit options and does not bind it; the SDK requires an authentication handler on the returned IHttpClientBuilder.

eventstore-inputs.owner: EventStore semantics; Platform composes one shared host
eventstore-inputs.boundary: Colon notation maps to double underscores in environment variables. Kubernetes secret-store references in existing fragments require reconciliation with Platform OpenBao/secret-contract scopes; no composed image is qualified here.

folders-server-and-workers-telemetry.owner: Platform telemetry owner; Folders ServiceDefaults consumes the key
folders-server-and-workers-telemetry.boundary: Server and Workers wire this exporter seam. UI does not call AddServiceDefaults in its current entry point; Platform/FrontComposer must qualify UI telemetry rather than assume the key alone enables it.

release-and-hosting.reason: No accepted retained Platform release or hosted composition is supplied.
release-and-hosting.contract: One retained application package and one Platform-composed eventstore host; existing module wrappers are inputs only.

profile.reason: Qualified common profile digest and provider versions are absent.
profile.contract: Same ratified template for staging and production; no separate Folders backend/topology gate.

namespaces-and-network.reason: Application/data namespaces, trust domains, Gateway and enforced isolation remain unbound.
namespaces-and-network.contract: Separate environment state, restricted pods, HotReload off and negative isolation matrix.

read-model.owner: Platform environment-layer owner with Folders and EventStore
read-model.reason: Qualified physical state backend and injected logical-role mapping are absent.
read-model.contract: Existing component statestore uses keyPrefix=none and the same physical backend for folders and folders-workers; fixed source names require AD-9 adoption.

broker.reason: Production durable broker and backlog/dead-letter recovery are unqualified.
broker.contract: folders-workers-pubsub inbound and shared outbound pubsub use one qualified broker; EventStore topic override is folders.events. Local Redis pubsub is not production qualification.

realm-and-workload-auth.owner: Platform instance; EventStore claim semantics; Administrator production authority
realm-and-workload-auth.reason: Issuer, audiences, client-to-surface map, scoped clients and token exchange remain unbound.
realm-and-workload-auth.contract: Real environment OIDC, actor plus workload checks, own-audience validation and receipt binding; no raw user-token forwarding authority.

projects-client-delegation.owner: Projects hosting owner with Platform and EventStore
projects-client-delegation.reason: Projects explicit AddFoldersClient has a hard-coded URI and no auth handler; no qualified authenticated transport is supplied.
projects-client-delegation.contract: Read-only SDK operations only; qualify downscoped delegation with original actor and surface, and authenticated client_id/azp attribution. Do not invent an endpoint/config key or token issuer.

ui-confidential-client.owner: Platform, FrontComposer and Folders UI owner
ui-confidential-client.reason: Current UI options do not expose confidential-client credential wiring and use bearer forwarding.
ui-confidential-client.contract: Qualify hosted confidential UI integration and target-scoped downstream delegation before enrollment.

provider-tenancy-and-egress.reason: Per-environment provider tenancy, least-privilege references and allowed egress are absent.
provider-tenancy-and-egress.contract: No real provider endpoints, payloads or effects in packet or smoke evidence; unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation.

secret-contract.owner: Platform scope owner; Administrator and module secret custodians
secret-contract.reason: Environment-specific OpenBao, per-app bootstrap/token mounts and acknowledged rotations are absent.
secret-contract.contract: Existing Kubernetes secret names are reference inputs only; reconcile to the environment secret contract without committing material.

telemetry.reason: Environment sink, exporter/egress, retention and off-site evidence are absent.
telemetry.contract: Capture api.version, consumer, status and durations; qualify Server, Workers and UI instrumentation separately.

attempt-controls.reason: Signed record encodings, CAS lock/epoch/stop store and scoped executor remain absent.
attempt-controls.contract: Administrator-approved pre-G3 mode still requires staging, provenance, lock, verification and records; packet grants no approval.

recovery.owner: Administrator and recovery deputy with Platform and module owners
recovery.reason: Usable recovery sets, hooks, fencing, response coverage and drill evidence are absent.
recovery.contract: Accepted 1h RPO/4h RTO, 7-day frequent/30-day daily retention and prepared-capacity restore; preserve keys, erasure, holds, revocations and external-effect reconciliation.
